title: Megastructure ink: endless structure drawn as ink line systems, a person stated only by a scale marker, black and cold grey with one light, white hairline HUD frames, monitor panels and an invented rail script
summary: Black and cold grey carry every screen; one cold cyan light (signal) marks the current state and stays under 3% of a screen. Structure is the subject: a one-point-perspective shaft drawn as an abstract ink line system (frames, screentone walls, ribs, beams, cables; never a figure, vehicle or object) fills the key visual, and a scale marker (a 10-unit tick for a person beside a 320-420 unit bracket for the structure) states the 1 : 2,000 ratio in numbers. Interfaces are white hairlines on black: corner-only frames, a depth ruler, segmented gauges, monitor label plates and a cyan monitor with 3-unit scanlines. Type is almost absent: a heavy CJK name compressed to 78% once, thin tracked titles, 12-unit labels with a Latin caps line, tabular readouts, and the pack's own rail script beside its reading.

provenance.case: megastructure-ink-kit (《穹井》 VAULTWELL): examples/megastructure-ink-kit in this repository — a seven-screen one-page official site (1920 and 390 wide, a ?slot=1 placeholder mode), two in-game screens (descent HUD, survey terminal), a 26-component design-system package and a gallery; every art slot has a task sheet and the key visual and portraits have layer contracts. Show mode carries every picture position with a procedural structure plate or with type and data, never a figure.
provenance.lineage: The grammar of manga about endless megastructures and their CG anime adaptation (1990s-2010s): monumental architecture with a tiny figure, dense ink and screentone, near-silent text, invented scripts, white-line cockpit and terminal HUDs on black, cyan monochrome monitors. Read and measured on reference images (tone shares, line orientation, edge density, figure-to-frame ratio, monitor colours); the images stay private and are not shipped. Borrowed: the grammar and the measured proportions. Never borrowed: any name, character, mecha, creature, organisation, logo, line of dialogue, picture, proprietary font or the references' own glyph scripts.
provenance.borrow: Borrow grammar, never assets. Every name, line, number and picture in the case and the templates is our own (穹井 VAULTWELL, 测深署, 缄默体, 接线台, 闻笛 and the other sounders); the rail script is drawn by our own generator; in show mode no figure, mecha or object is drawn in code - structure is an abstract line system and people are a scale marker - and in slot mode every picture is a sized placeholder waiting for original art from an image-generation task sheet and its layer contract.
provenance.rounds: template check --browser on the case: first pass 566 findings over 5 pages (site 1920 277, site 390 249, HUD 17, terminal 4, gallery 19): sections sized 100vh grew with the check canvas (off-canvas; screens are now min(100vh, 1080px)), minus signs, degrees, middle dots and arrows outside the Latin subsets and CJK set in the data face (glyph coverage; the subsets were widened and CJK readouts switch face), a skip link above the page; then 5 contrast findings on dim decorative codes (now data-deco) and a caption under the bar in slot mode; final 0 on all five pages and the slot-mode page.
measured: Reference manga pages: 67-79% of the frame is dense structure (20-unit blocks with over 15% edges), edge density 29-34% at 800 px, black (L<40) 12-42%, light (L>170) 23-58%, ink centre at x 0.48-0.52 / y 0.49-0.54; each page has one dominant line direction (horizontals 46% or verticals 42%).
Figure height / frame height 8.2-8.8% where a person appears: a 1 : 11-12 scale contrast; one page has no person at all.

Reference monitors: face #0993BE, highlights #73EDEE (99th percentile about #77EEF3), surround #0E1C23; a dark label plate #066B79 about 2.4% of frame height with a thin CJK label; scanlines about 4 units at 1920.
Reference interface frames: edge density 2.4-3.2%, black 59%: the HUD voice is empty and dark, the manga voice is dense; the pack keeps both apart (plates dense, interfaces empty).
Case: signal 0.06-0.54% of a screen, alarm at most 0.35%; the hero plate covers 54% of the screen with texture; the name is 128 units over 12-unit labels (10.7 : 1).

64 px: beside the references the plate screens (key visual, world, alarm, descent, HUD) read as this grammar; the interface-only screens read nearest the dark dossier pack (near-black with one cyan) and are told apart by the plate, the scale marker and the rail script.

fonts.resolve: fonts query --text-file <all copy> --style gothic resolves the CJK roles (the case's copy on all four pages: Noto Sans SC covers it). Michroma and Chakra Petch are Latin only (fonts measure --path): strings with CJK go to body, never wide or data; the data role also needs − (U+2212), °, ·, ×, – and → in the face, which both faces carry (a subset must keep them). The proprietary display face of the lineage is not used; the heavy name is Noto Sans SC 900 compressed to 78%, which keeps the vertical stems and thins the horizontals more than a true condensed cut.
fonts.licence: All roles use SIL OFL 1.1 fonts.
fonts.note: Fonts are named, not bundled. --font-dir <dir> reads coverage and embeds the faces; the tests supply OFL subsets (tests/fixtures/megastructure-ink/fonts) and the skill's own Noto Sans SC woffs.

grammar: Structure is the subject: the key visual's plate fills the top 70% of the screen (a one-point-perspective shaft, 18-26 levels shrinking about 0.82 a level toward an off-centre vanishing point, rolled -9 to +7 degrees) and a black floor holds the type below 66%.
No person is drawn: a scale marker states the scale - a 10-unit tick (1.7 m) beside a 320-420 unit bracket (3,400 m) and the ratio in signal - on a scrim over the plate.
Black and cold grey; one light (signal #7FE6EA) for the current state, the primary button and live readouts, under 3% of a screen; alarm red only for hostile contact and refused lines.

Type is almost absent: the name once at 128 units (900, compressed to 78%), thin titles tracked 0.24em, 12-unit labels tracked 0.2em over a 10-unit Latin caps line, tabular readouts in the data face; the name is at least 10 times a label.

Interfaces are white hairlines on black: frames are corners only (14 units), a depth ruler with 8-unit minor and 64-unit major ticks, segmented gauges of 24 cells, monitor label plates (a square tile, a dark plate with a thin label and caps, a caption).
Monitors are a cyan-tinted face (#072A2F) with 3-unit scanlines; time codes and kinds in signal, lines in text, a refused line marked with a 2-unit alarm edge.
The rail script (the pack's own glyphs: bars hung on a baseline rail, generated from the character code) appears beside its reading as a signature mark, never alone.

procedural: the structure plate: an abstract shaft drawn as an ink line system (frames, screentone walls by depth, panel seams, ribs, a beam, cables, a black core with one light slit) - shaft() in layouts-ink.cjs and templates/plates.js in the case
screentone: 45-degree dot screens in four tone steps on the paper colour
scanlines: a 3-unit line pattern in scanline over the monitor face
the rail script: railLayout() in layouts-ink.cjs
recipes: Paper grit under a plate: materials generate --generator paper --params '{"profile":"laid-cream","pxPerMm":4}' --seed 2, desaturated and multiplied at 18% over the plate.

Coarser print screen for a still: materials generate --generator halftone --params '{"periodPx":5,"angleDeg":45,"shape":"round","mode":"am","ink":"#0A0B0B","paper":"none"}' --seed 3, laid at 10% in multiply.

Figures, creatures, mecha and real key art come from an image-generation task sheet (#311): one sheet per frame with its size, safe box, the boxes left for UI, a cold top light with a signal rim, the palette and 'original characters only'; the person in a key visual stays 8-9% of the frame height. Cut-outs go in with materials cut --mode none --finish cut and the layer contract (examples/megastructure-ink-kit/layers).
collage: Pictures sit inside art slots or full-bleed behind the type with a void floor or a scrim under every line of text; no picture carries text.
materials.sources: Everything is drawn; pictures are your own art in the image slots.

grammar: Signals blink on hard steps: live dots and cursors 1060 ms a cycle (530 on / 530 off), the alarm frame 880 ms (under 3 flashes a second); never a fade.
Measuring things sweep slowly and linearly: scan heads and the sonar once every 4.2 s.
Terminal lines print at 28 ms a character; frames trace in from their corners over 640 ms on cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); plates are drawn once per size, never animated.
motion.flashLimit: Alarm blinking stays under 3 flashes a second and stops under reduced motion.

guidance: 64 px distinctiveness (guidance): shrink each screen to 64 px tall beside the references, street-tape, lattice-dossier and the other packs with the logo masked; the grey screentone plate with its perspective rings and a black floor, or white hairline corners around a plate, should read. A screen with no plate (only black panels and one cyan) reads as lattice-dossier: give it a plate, the scale marker or the rail script.

Show mode without figures (guidance): never draw a person, mecha, creature, weapon or object in code - it reads cheap next to drawn references. Structure is drawn as an abstract line system (perspective frames, screentone, ribs, cables) and must pass the 64 px test beside the references; people are stated by the scale marker; everything else is an art slot with a task sheet and a layer contract.

Whole-screen first: measure the plate's share of the screen (texture area), the visual centre and the dark/light shares before the components; the references keep 67-79% of the frame as dense structure.

Sections sized in viewport units grow with the check canvas: cap them (min(100vh, 1080px)) and check the page at its real height, or the browser check reports everything below the first screen as off-canvas.
The data face carries digits, , . and − ° · × – → only: a readout or unit with CJK (静默, 次, 处) switches to body, or the browser check reports glyph coverage.
Never set a mixed CJK and Latin string in Michroma or Chakra Petch (glyph coverage); never let the rail script carry information alone.
checks.note: The browser check runs on every render (the plate, the scanlines and the scale marker are measured in pixels).

examples.note: The case lives in the repository at examples/megastructure-ink-kit (pages, design-system package, task sheets, layer contracts); its pages stay example renders, the bank keeps the parametric parts.
